decks.notes: The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control your opponent's game plan while efficiently cycling through your own deck using cards like Mental Note, Thought Scour, and Brainstorm. By utilizing powerful removal spells like Snuff Out and Agony Warp, alongside countermagic with cards like Counterspell and Spell Pierce, you can maintain control of the game. Gurmag Angler serves as a powerful finisher, while cards like Deep Analysis provide card advantage. The deck also includes versatile removal options like Cast Down and Unexpected Fangs to handle various threats.

The deck focuses on playing cheap artifact creatures like Myr Enforcer and Gearseeker Serpent to quickly overwhelm the opponent, utilizing the Affinity mechanic to reduce the cost of artifacts. Krark-Clan Shaman and Galvanic Blast help deal with opposing threats, while Ichor Wellspring and Blood Fountain provide card advantage. The deck also includes various artifact lands and Bridges to support the Affinity strategy. Makeshift Munitions can act as a finisher with all the artifacts in the deck. Overall, the deck aims to flood the board with threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this Gruul Aggro deck is to ramp up mana quickly with cards like Utopia Sprawl and Arbor Elf, allowing for early aggressive plays using creatures like Boarding Party and Annoyed Altisaur. The deck also includes removal spells like Skred and Mwonvuli Acid-Moss to control the board and disrupt opponents. With a combination of ramp, efficient creatures, and removal, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with high-powered threats and end the game quickly.

The main focus of this aggro Red Deck Wins deck is to quickly and efficiently deal damage to the opponent through a combination of cheap creatures, burn spells, and aggressive tactics. By utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Goblin Bushwhacker, as well as direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a fast victory. The deck also includes cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Implement of Combustion to provide additional damage and card advantage, while cards like Voldaren Epicure and Reckless Impulse help maintain pressure on the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to create a combo that overwhelms the opponent with poison counters while generating mana through various sources. By using cards like Vivisurgeon's Insight and Prologue to Phyresis, the deck aims to quickly accumulate poison counters on the opponent. This is supported by card draw spells like Deep Analysis and Compulsive Research, along with mana ramp cards like Everflowing Chalice and Pentad Prism. The deck also includes protection and life gain with Weather the Storm, as well as additional support with Contentious Plan and Thirsting Roots. The lands in the deck are designed to support the mana requirements of the combo.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly play low-cost aggressive creatures like Kiln Fiend and Monastery Swiftspear, buff them up with spells like Temur Battle Rage and Mutagenic Growth, and finish off the opponent with burst damage from cards like Lightning Bolt. Faithless Looting helps to filter through the deck and find the needed cards, while Festival Crasher provides extra sources of damage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, powerful creatures and efficient spells to deal a lot of damage quickly and win the game.

The Mono Green Aggro deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with cards like Wild Growth and Utopia Sprawl, allowing for early plays of powerful creatures like Arbor Elf, Llanowar Visionary, and Troll of Khazad-dûm. The deck also features removal spells like Snuff Out and Cast Down to deal with opposing threats. By combining efficient mana ramp with strong aggressive creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and finish the game quickly through combat damage.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to efficiently control the game by disrupting opponent's strategy through counter spells and removal cards like Snuff Out and Cast Down. Using card draw spells like Mental Note and Thought Scour to fuel graveyard for threats like Gurmag Angler, and finish off the opponent with unexpected damage from Unexpected Fangs or Tolarian Terror. The deck also includes tools for recursion with cards like Fallaji Archaeologist and Lórien Revealed, maintaining a strong board presence while constantly disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive red creatures and burn spells, utilizing cheap and efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning to deal damage directly to the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Goblin Bushwhacker to create a wide board presence and finish the game quickly. The use of cards like Implement of Combustion and Voldaren Epicure provide additional reach and damage potential, while cards like Wrenn's Resolve help protect the creatures from removal spells.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying small creatures and using various artifacts to deal damage to the opponent. It utilizes efficient creatures like Kor Skyfisher and Glint Hawk, along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast to maintain pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes artifact lands like Ancient Den and Great Furnace to enable Metalcraft abilities, enhancing the power of cards like Krark-Clan Shaman. By combining creature aggression with direct damage, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with efficient burn spells and aggressive creatures. By playing cheap and powerful cards like Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning, combined with Monastery Swiftspear and Kessig Flamebreather, the goal is to deal damage quickly and efficiently. The deck also includes card draw and extra burn spells to maintain pressure and finish off the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of Experimental Synthesizer and Dwarven Forge-Chanter provide additional versatility and options for the player to adapt to different situations.

The deck focuses on utilizing control elements like spot removal and board wipes to maintain board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also employs token generation and value engines to provide continuous advantage. The Golgari/Jund color combination allows for efficient removal and recursion, while also providing access to graveyard synergies. The deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent with a mix of removal, card draw, and threats, ultimately grinding out a win through attrition and resiliency.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to create a fast and aggressive strategy by consistently playing low-cost creatures like Thraben Inspector and Sacred Cat, while also utilizing cards that provide additional value like Squadron Hawk and Battle Screech. The deck also includes removal spells like Lightning Bolt to deal with opposing threats and ways to give creatures additional power like Greatsword of Tyr. The mana base consists of a mix of Plains and Mountains with Boros Garrison and Sacred Peaks to help with color fixing.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game using a combination of removal spells, counter spells, and card draw while utilizing the mechanic of Ephemerate to gain additional value from key creatures like Mulldrifter and Archaeomancer. The deck aims to maintain board presence through efficient removal like Skred and Lightning Bolt, while also disrupting opponent's strategies with counterspells. The inclusion of Cleansing Wildfire helps with mana fixing and disrupting opponent's lands. Overall, the goal is to outvalue the opponent and control the game until securing a win condition.

The main focus of this deck is to gain control of the game by using a combination of card draw, removal spells, and counterspells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck leans heavily on Delve cards like Gurmag Angler to quickly put pressure on the opponent while also utilizing cards like Thought Scour to fill the graveyard. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by efficiently using its resources and generating card advantage through cards like Deep Analysis. Overall, the deck looks to control the game and win through incremental advantage.

The main concept of this deck revolves around using control elements like counterspells and removal spells to stall the opponent's game plan. The deck also utilizes cards that can provide card advantage or card selection, such as Brainstorm and Preordain. The Gates archetype allows for additional mana fixing and synergy with cards like Basilisk Gate and Citadel Gate. The inclusion of creatures like Squadron Hawk and Guardian of the Guildpact provides a win condition and resilience against aggression. Overall, the deck aims to control the game until it can establish a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent.
